event.distribution_pattern: New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Virginia, and Maryland

products.product_description: Wawa Black Forest Ham and Cheese on a Pretzel Roll with swiss cheese and country dijon honey mustard. Net Wt. 8.7 oz (247g). Distributed by Wawa, Inc., Wawa, PA 19063.
products.reason_for_recall: Taylor Farms New Jersey, Inc. of Swedesboro, NJ is voluntarily recalling a limited quantity of Black Forest Ham and Cheese on a Pretzel Roll with swiss cheese and country dijon honey mustard because they have the potential of containing an undeclared tree nut allergen.
